items.title: Lew Soloff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: I really loved Bill Haley and his Comets.

ctx.x: Were you affected by the rock ‘n roll scene that was forming at the time also?

Yes, yes. I was affected by it but I didn’t pick up on it because I was advised by adults that it wasn’t good music and that I shouldn’t listen to it. But had I not been advised by that, I can tell you that “Rock Around the Clock,” “Blackboard Jungle,” when that music happened in the beginning, that really sent chills up me. I loved that music. I really loved Bill Haley and his Comets. I loved it. It moved the hell out of me — it moved the hell out of every— do you remember that movie?
